newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Andina mulls holding company.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Andina mulls holding company.

text.p: Chilean soft drinks bottler Embotelladora Andina is studying creating a holding company but has not reached any decision, said a top official.
"We have studied creating a holding company but have not made any decision yet," Pedro Pelligrini, corporate legal manager, told Reuters.
Chilean media reported Thursday that the company was planning to set up a holding company and would transfer most of its Chilean assets to a new division.
Andina, Chile's largest Coca-Colo bottler, also has investments in Argentina and Brazil.
